title: koeleria uniflora
intro: Koeleria uniflora, commonly known as June Grass, is a perennial grass species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria uniflora include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria uniflora include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
